::: {.intro-artigos}
Everyday problems for anyone monitoring deforestation, fire and protected areas in Brazil, each one
solved in **ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, PostGIS and Python**, with open data and code you can copy. Pick your
program in the tabs of one article, and the others open on it.
